sub_graphs.title: Berlin Access List Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models how access list transactions are processed with pre-warmed storage slots

nodes.label: Transaction Received
nodes.description: Transaction (potentially with access list) pending processing

nodes.label: Check Transaction
nodes.description: Validate: available gas, nonce match, balance >= gas*price + value, sender is EOA

nodes.label: Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Transaction passed all pre-execution checks

nodes.label: Extract Access List
nodes.description: Extract pre-specified addresses and storage keys from transaction access list

nodes.label: Access List Extracted
nodes.description: Access list contents ready for pre-warming

nodes.label: Pre-warm Addresses
nodes.description: Mark access list addresses as 'warm' in the access set before execution

nodes.label: Pre-warm Storage Keys
nodes.description: Mark access list storage slots as 'warm' reducing subsequent access costs

nodes.label: Warmth Applied
nodes.description: All access list entries marked as warm

nodes.label: Execute Message Call
nodes.description: Execute transaction with reduced gas for warm accesses

nodes.label: Transaction Executed
nodes.description: Transaction execution complete

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Refund
nodes.description: Refund capped at 50% of gas consumed

nodes.label: Pay Mining Fee
nodes.description: Transfer gas_used * gas_price to coinbase

nodes.label: Transaction Complete
nodes.description: Transaction fully processed with receipt generated

external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
external_entities.description: External account that signed and submitted the transaction with access list

nodes.description: Deduct reduced gas cost for warm storage/account access

nodes.label: Access Complete
nodes.description: Storage/account access completed with appropriate gas charged

nodes.description: Verify sender nonce matches account nonce

ambiguities.text: The exact gas costs for warm vs cold access are not specified in the index documentation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-2929 values: Cold account access = 2600 gas, Cold slot access = 2100 gas, Warm access = 100 gas

ambiguities.text: The behavior when an access list contains duplicate addresses or storage keys is not explicitly defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume duplicates are deduplicated during processing - each address/slot is marked warm only once regardless of duplicates in access list

implicit_assumptions.description: Access list gas costs accurately reflect the true cost of storage access, preventing economic attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mispriced gas could enable DoS attacks by undercharging for expensive operations

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot construct access lists that cause disproportionate state bloat or processing cost
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Access lists could be weaponized for block stuffing or node resource exhaustion

implicit_assumptions.description: The 9M block bomb delay provides sufficient time for The Merge to be completed
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain could become unusable if merge is delayed beyond bomb activation

implicit_assumptions.description: Transaction senders correctly estimate which addresses and slots they will access
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inefficient access lists waste gas on unused warm entries or miss entries causing higher cold costs
